name: Spotlight Narrative
description: FORMAT: a cinematic flat-vector story told one beat per scene. A dark moody room with a vignette, a single spotlight cone that lands on a glowing floor ellipse, slowly pulsing concentric rings, floating dust in the beam, a slow warm light leak and film grain. Each scene centers one icon metaphor inside glowing rings with a big counting number, or a layered flat-vector drawing with soft light, under a calm serif headline with a tracked kicker. Slow push-ins and parallax, word-by-word captions low in the frame. The metaphors, numbers and drawn props are new in every video: the format is the light, the camera and the pacing, never a fixed subject. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Tell a short story in 5-9 scenes (4-7 s each), one idea and one beat per scene, building from a quiet hook to a turn and a closing line. title.kicker is a tiny tracked tag (a place, a time, a chapter) and title.main one calm sentence (max ~30 chars). Put ONE focal element in each scene: beacon (an icon metaphor in glowing rings with a big counting number: icon, value, from, prefix, suffix, label, rings 2-5) or a drawing element (a layered flat-vector scene drawn with parts: far, mid and near layers, a light source, soft shadows; draw it new for this story). Use counter, stat or card only as a support. Choose a different icon metaphor and a different drawn subject in every scene and every video; never reuse the example's objects. Numbers must be real or clearly hypothetical. Keep narration short and visual: the captions are word-by-word at the bottom. Never use emoji.
